mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines over the past 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.5% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%, or Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates broad-based economic weakness that triggers negative equity market reactions, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and PAYEMS decline, or Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 120.0 indicates strong manufacturing activity that supports corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods during late-cycle expansion when INDPRO exceeds 120.0, or Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the core inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) over the past 3 months signals rising inflation expectations that erode real equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises over the past 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When month-over-month non-farm payrolls growth (PAYEMS) falls below 50,000, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS growth is below 50,000, or Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a sharp drop in consumer demand that triggers negative equity market reactions, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a post-recession recovery, a quarterly GDP growth rate (GDPC1) above 3.0% signals strong economic expansion that boosts corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods during post-recession recovery when GDPC1 exceeds 3.0%, or Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
